$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs in CI (manager/rules/SEO.md). actorId is added after the first deploy.
seoDescription: Search 2,300+ companies hiring on Lever in one run: job titles, salary ranges with pay period, locations, remote work and posting dates. No login or key.
defaultRunOptions$comment: TODO_DEPLOYED: measure on the deployed build, one run at a time, the empty form {"maxJobs":100} at 1024 and 2048 MB (seconds, usageTotalUsd, usage.DATA_TRANSFER_EXTERNAL_GBYTES, peak memory, run ids) and keep the cheaper size that finishes it well inside 300 s; about 0.08 GB of transfer means Cloudflare answered, about 1 GB that the run fell back to api.lever.co. 2 GB until then: every search reads all 2,396 job sites, 2,403 calls and about 81 MB of gzip; on the laptop (2026-11-02, b- runs on engine 59bf5e0) the empty form took 101 s, the example input 117 s and a description search 78 to 100 s, peaking at 770 to 920 MiB resident (819 MiB footprint for a description search measured alone), with 16 to 29 s of CPU, which Apify shares out by memory. minMemoryMbytes is 1024 for those peaks: raise it to 2048 if a run at 1 GB peaks near 1 GB or fails. The run start is $0.005 per GB, $0.01 at 2 GB: if the default changes, change the cost lines of README.md and llms.txt with it.

pricing.$comment: 2026-11-02 (Store scan of 3,631 listings at 23:14 UTC, prices from GET /v2/acts, last pricingInfos record in force). Rule: rules/SEO.md section 16. Main competitor: fantastic-jobs/lever-co-jobs-api, the most used actor made for Lever (76 u30): $0.0025 a job on FREE (BRONZE $0.002, SILVER $0.0012, GOLD and up $0.0008), no start fee, one row with the description from its database of jobs posted in the last 6 months, no company list needed. job $0.0022 is 12% under it and job-details $0.0023 8% under it on FREE. Others that name Lever: fantastic-jobs/career-site-job-listing-api 1,632 u30 ($0.012 + $0.01 start, 58 ATS database), bovi 100 ($0.0015 + $0.00005, companies or presets), yugenox 86 ($0.002, live keyword search on Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby, the closest design), memo23 81 ($0.004 + $0.03), viridian 53 ($0.0015 + $0.00005). Run start, apify-actor-start at $0.005 flat, charged by Apify once up to 1 GB and once more per extra GB ($0.01 at the default 2 GB): Lever has no search, so every search reads all 2,396 job sites whatever it finds, about 81 MB of gzip ($0.016 of external transfer at $0.20 a GB) plus 100 to 270 s of compute at 2 GB ($0.011 to $0.030), about $0.028 to $0.047 a run (estimate, TODO_DEPLOYED). Without a start, a paid run under 16 to 27 rows loses money; with it, under 11 to 22. A 100-row run costs 12 to 20% of its $0.23 even so, over the 10% rule, which holds from about 125 to 210 rows. A start event can be cut at once later through CI, while adding one needs Console and 14 days, so it is defined now. Cut it to $0.00005 before going public if a measured full pass at the default memory costs under $0.015. Gentle ladder per the owner's decision of 2026-10-29 on the two job events; the start stays flat.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, locations, work type, job type, department, team, pay, posting date, job link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, pay as numbers with its currency and period, country and country code.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged by Apify when a run starts: once up to 1 GB of memory and once more for each extra GB, so $0.01 at the default 2 GB. It pays for reading all of Lever's job sites, about 81 MB, that every search makes whatever it finds.
